card.name: Step-down monitoring schedule wording
card.fires_on: Words that set the next interval in a lab or ECG monitoring schedule, such as "every", "more frequently", "then at" after an earlier, tighter interval. It fires in sentences like "weekly for the first month, then every 4 weeks".

modes.label: Next interval after 'then'
modes.description: The word "every" or "at" that begins a longer interval after an initial schedule.
modes.example: until a major molecular response is re-established, then<< every>> 12 weeks.

modes.label: More frequently
modes.description: "more" or "frequently" in a phrase saying to monitor more often than the baseline schedule.
modes.example: Monitor ECG weekly and more<< frequently>> for clinically unstable patients.

modes.label: Initial period words
modes.description: Words like "first", "month" or "initially" marking the starting phase of a monitoring schedule.
modes.example: blood counts were monitored every week<< initially>>.

card.writes: It adds little clear output; the promoted tokens are mixed and not obviously tied to monitoring.
card.plain: It lights up on words that spell out how often to check labs or tests over the course of treatment.
